### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=120 check=False
set -u
result() { printf 'RESULT=%s\nREASON=%s\n' "$1" "${2:-}"; exit 0; }
physical() { (cd -P -- "$1" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); }
check_target() {
  if [ -L "$1" ]; then result refused symlink; fi
  if [ ! -e "$1" ]; then result absent; fi
  if [ ! -d "$1" ]; then result refused not-a-directory; fi
  if [ "$(physical "$1")" != "$2" ]; then result refused symlink; fi
}
no_container() {
  command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
  names=$(docker ps --all --format '{{.Names}}') || result refused docker-unavailable
  for name in "$@"; do
    if printf '%s\n' "$names" | grep -Fxq -- "$name"; then
      result refused container-exists
    fi
  done
}
docker_ready() {
  command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || result absent no-docker
  docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}' >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || result refused docker-unavailable
}
case "$HOME" in /?*) ;; *) result refused home ;; esac
home=$(physical "$HOME")
if [ -z "$home" ] || [ "$home" != "$(physical /home/spark)" ]; then result refused home-mismatch; fi
check_target /home/spark/.local/share/dgx-spark-controller/recipes/g-qwen3-8b-00aa11 "$home"/.local/share/dgx-spark-controller/recipes/g-qwen3-8b-00aa11
no_container dgxc-g-qwen3-8b-00aa11
rm -rf -- /home/spark/.local/share/dgx-spark-controller/recipes/g-qwen3-8b-00aa11 || result failed rm
rmdir -- /home/spark/.local/share/dgx-spark-controller/recipes /home/spark/.local/share/dgx-spark-controller 2>/dev/null || true
result removed

### call 3: node=spark-1 timeout=600 check=False
set -u
result() { printf 'RESULT=%s\nREASON=%s\n' "$1" "${2:-}"; exit 0; }

check_target() {

  if [ "$(physical "$1")" != "$2" ]; then result refused symlink; fi

no_container() {
  command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
  names=$(docker ps --all --format '{{.Names}}') || result refused docker-unavailable

docker_ready() {

root=$(physical /home/spark/models)
if [ -z "$root" ]; then result absent; fi
check_target /home/spark/models/Qwen--Qwen3-8B-b968826d "$root"/Qwen--Qwen3-8B-b968826d
if systemctl --user list-units --all --no-legend --plain --state=active,activating 'dgx-prepare-*.service' 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then result refused prepare-active; fi
if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  running=$(docker ps --no-trunc --format '{{.Names}} {{.Command}}') || result refused docker-unavailable
  if printf '%s\n' "$running" | grep -q '^dgxc-prepare-'; then result refused prepare-active; fi
  if printf '%s\n' "$running" | grep -Fq -- /Qwen--Qwen3-8B-b968826d; then result refused in-use; fi
fi
rm -rf -- /home/spark/models/Qwen--Qwen3-8B-b968826d || result failed rm
result removed
### call 4: node=spark-1 timeout=300 check=False
set -u
result() { printf 'RESULT=%s\nREASON=%s\n' "$1" "${2:-}"; exit 0; }
physical() { (cd -P -- "$1" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); }

no_container() {
  command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

docker_ready
docker image inspect vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa >/dev/null 2>&1 || result absent
id=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) || result refused docker-unavailable
users=$(docker ps --all --quiet --filter "ancestor=$id") || result refused docker-unavailable
if [ -n "$users" ]; then result refused in-use; fi
docker image rm -- vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa >/dev/null 2>&1 || result failed image-rm
result removed

set -u
result() { printf 'RESULT=%s\nREASON=%s\n' "$1" "${2:-}"; exit 0; }
physical() { (cd -P -- "$1" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); }
check_target() {
  if [ -L "$1" ]; then result refused symlink; fi

  if [ ! -d "$1" ]; then result refused not-a-directory; fi
  if [ "$(physical "$1")" != "$2" ]; then result refused symlink; fi

no_container() {
  command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

  for name in "$@"; do
    if printf '%s\n' "$names" | grep -Fxq -- "$name"; then

    fi
  done
}
docker_ready() {
  command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || result absent no-docker
  docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}' >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || result refused docker-unavailable
}
docker_ready
docker volume inspect dgx-spark-controller-cache >/dev/null 2>&1 || result absent
users=$(docker ps --all --quiet --filter volume=dgx-spark-controller-cache) || result refused docker-unavailable
if [ -n "$users" ]; then result refused in-use; fi
docker volume rm -- dgx-spark-controller-cache >/dev/null 2>&1 || result failed volume-rm
result removed
